headline: Witkoff ARRIVES St. Petersburg for Putin meeting
dek: US envoy Steve Witkoff arrived Wednesday in St. Petersburg to meet Putin with Ukraine-developed peace ideas; Kirill Dmitriev will join; Jared Kushner joins remotely; Rubio says Oslo talks with Zelensky were 'positive, nothing unexpected/surprising'
sources: Reuters (via JPost 09:07 IDT; northlandnewsradio/wnflsports radio wires; LaPresse/Axios recap)
fault_line: Is Witkoff brokering peace or handing Putin a win? Ukraine-skeptical commenters call him a 'traitor' / pro-Russia businessman vs supporters of any ceasefire deal

sections.what_happened: US envoy Steve Witkoff arrived Wednesday in St. Petersburg to meet Putin with Ukraine-developed peace ideas; Kirill Dmitriev will join; Jared Kushner joins remotely; Rubio says Oslo talks with Zelensky were 'positive, nothing unexpected/surprising'
